programme_facts.value: The University of Limerick has a proven track record in supporting student-athletes, helping them to excel both in their sport and in their studies.
Whether you're pursuing personal fitness goals or developing as a student-athlete, UL provides the ideal environment to thrive—both in the classroom and on the field.
